profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a variety of experiences working across the stack, primarily in JavaScript (and TypeScript), React, Redux, and GraphQL. Seasoned through a range of experiences in computer science, data science, and design, Erick's worked with Node.js/Express.js, in SQL/NoSQL databases, and applied Test-Driven Development with libraries Jest, SuperTest, and React Testing Library. Erick is passionate about effective design and user experience.

Currently developing moleQLar, an open-source GraphQL product that automatically generates type definitions and resolver functions over a PostgreSQL database.

Recently spoke at Tech Talk sponsored by Remake Labs.

Outside of work, Erick is a music producer and web designer.

Feel free to reach out at erick924alvarez@gmail.com

You can find his work at https://github.com/erick505alvarez

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: Next.js · React.js · User Experience (UX) · Tailwind CSS · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created 25+ Tailwind CSS components and 6+ layouts by using atomic design, reducing style conflict and dev friction
• Engineered a Redis Pub/Sub system to promote real-time messaging across WebSocket servers with ~400ms in latency
• Reduced load time by over 2.5+ seconds by caching chat sessions using React Query to prefetch and retry requests
• Deployed 8 microservices on a VPS, validating consistent environments while streamlining debugging across services
positions.insights: Skills: Tailwind CSS · Redis · React Query

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Advanced deployment of app to AWS ECS/ ECR, assisting with container integration and environment configuration
• Created GraphQL API over PostgreSQL to simplify 15+ frontend queries and cut data payload sizes by more than 15%
• Collaborated with UI/UX teams to design 10+ Figma mockups, guiding shared understanding and project consistency
• Configured 20+ unit tests via React Testing Library and Jest, achieving 70%+ coverage and preventing regression bugs
• Leveraged React’s stateful components to employ modularity and boost performance through the use of the virtual DOM

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Built over 20 modular components using Figma and React, streamlining UI consistency and improving dev reusability
• Managed 10+ global state values with Redux, eliminating 90%+ of prop-drilling issues across multi-level components
• Styled 20+ responsive elements by using SASS variables, mixins, and functions to simplify logic and reduce repetition
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 with JWTs to sync styles with a custom Figma plugin and automate style variable creation
• Developed REST APIs with Express.js, using middleware to efficiently manage frontend and backend communications
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Redux · Docker · Express.js · Next.js · Supabase · PostgreSQL · JSON Web Token (JWT) · TypeScript

positions.title: Technology Lead
positions.description:
• Built Python tools to model $140B+ in portfolio risk, automating analysis using Pandas and Matplotlib
• Developed PostgreSQL schemas and automation pipelines that saved 20+ hours of manual work per quarter
• Authored pricing and analytics scripts that contributed to over $50M in trading fee savings for institutional clients
• Facilitated internal training sessions and presented tooling to 45+ global PMs, improving firmwide data clarity
• Collaborated with data and engineering teams to align trade execution tools with investment strategy workflows

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Built and launched a branded e-commerce microsite using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to support initial product rollout
• Designed and implemented lightweight frontend to minimize hosting costs while ensuring mobile-friendly responsiveness
• Managed Amazon FBA inventory, logistics, and product listings, integrating backend tracking with marketing channels
• Conducted keyword research and SEO tagging to improve visibility and organic product discovery
• Coordinated trademark registration and brand positioning strategy to prepare for long-term scale and growth

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Partnered with university professors to teach students during lab hours as well as grade weekly assignments, midterms, and final exams for computer science courses in Java object-oriented programming
• Utilized Trello to manage the grading, tutoring, and proctoring labs and exams for more than 800 UCSD students across 6 quarters
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Computer Science · Computer Science Education

positions.title: Goldman Sachs Undergraduate Camp
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• Chosen as one of 102 attendees ot attend an exclusive, immersive program at Goldman Sachs, gaining insight into divisions like asset management, technology, and risk management
• Gained acomprehensive understanding of how technology drives innovation in financial services through hands-on learning across multiple sectors
• Built valuable connections with industry leaders and peers, deepening my passion for leveraging technology to solve complex challenges in finance

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute
positions.description:
• Selected for an exclusive, educational program at Google's Mountain View headquarters
• Gained hands-on experience ni web application development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, while leveraging Google AppEngine for scalable application deployment
• Collaborated with a team ot build a web application, integrating Yelp, Google Maps, and Meetup APis, which showcased practical application of API consumption and front-end development skils
• Worked closely with Google engineers, enhancing my understanding of best practices ni software development and solidifying my passion for technology

honors.issuer: Issued by Provost of Revelle College

volunteerExperiences.description:
The Emerging Leaders Program at UC San Diego aims to guide, challenge, and inspire the development of leadership skills through experiential, direct, and reflective learning while simultaneously planning a community service project event to make a difference in the lives of the less fortunate living in the greater San Diego area.
As a member of the organization, I assisted in the synergic planning of the 2017 Emerging Leaders Community Project that worked to help struggling homeless individuals living in the Operation HOPE - Vista homeless shelter in Vista, CA. It was a great experience as I collaborated with other members who were similarly interested passionate about community service and giving back to the community. We worked to facilitate the event that benefitted more than 40 adults and children at the homeless shelter. I personally worked on the logistical committee to contact facilitators and comprise the planning of the event that allowed for the successful execution of the community project.

It was truly an unforgettable experience.

projects.title: Syncify (Spotify to Youtube)
projects.description:
• Implemented Material UI theme customization in Figma and styled-components to ensure consistent, modular frontend styling across views

• Optimized Webpack builds by minifying ES6+ code, enabling hot module reloading, and configuring tree-shaking for smaller, faster-loading bundles

volunteerExperience.description:
The Emerging Leaders Program at UC San Diego aims to guide, challenge, and inspire the development of leadership skills through experiential, direct, and reflective learning while simultaneously planning a community service project event to make a difference in the lives of the less fortunate living in the greater San Diego area.
As a member of the organization, I assisted in the synergic planning of the 2017 Emerging Leaders Community Project that worked to help struggling homeless individuals living in the Operation HOPE - Vista homeless shelter in Vista, CA. It was a great experience as I collaborated with other members who were similarly interested passionate about community service and giving back to the community. We worked to facilitate the event that benefitted more than 40 adults and children at the homeless shelter. I personally worked on the logistical committee to contact facilitators and comprise the planning of the event that allowed for the successful execution of the community project.

It was truly an unforgettable experience.
